children: shares tumbled about 10% in morning trading after the e-commerce platform reported third-quarter revenue and gross merchandise volume below analyst estimates.
Revenue rose 32% to $3.74 billion, just under the $3.75 billion Bloomberg estimate. Adjusted earnings of 49 cents a share beat the 46 cents Koyfin expected.

Gross merchandise volume, the total value of orders processed on its platform, rose about 29.5% to $119.15 billion, below the roughly $120 billion forecast. Subscription Solutions revenue climbed 20% to $836 million, missing the $850.2 million estimate.
Merchant Solutions revenue rose 35% to $2.91 billion, slightly ahead of estimates. Free cash flow climbed to $816 million from $507 million, and operating income rose 66% to $568 million.
For the fourth quarter, Shopify expects revenue to grow at a low-30s percentage rate and gross profit dollars at a high-20s rate. It also expects operating expenses of 29% to 30% of revenue.
Shopify also filed a shelf registration statement with the SEC on Tuesday, a document that lets a company sell securities in future transactions.

title: Shopify Stock Suffers Brutal Sell-Off After Weak Holiday Quarter Outlook
